## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `jira-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to your Atlassian account

1. <!-- manual: Go to [id.atlassian.com](https://id.atlassian.com) and log in. -->
2. After logging in, you are redirected to your Atlassian account dashboard.

## Step 3: Create an API token

1. Navigate to your profile by selecting your avatar in the top-right corner, then select **Manage account**.
2. Select **Security** in the left sidebar.
3. Under **API token**, select **Create and manage API tokens**.
4. Select **Create API token**.
5. Enter a **Label** for the token (for example, `Ballerina Jira Connector`).
6. Select **Create**.
7. <!-- manual: Enter a Label for the token (for example, Ballerina Jira Connector) and select Create. -->
8. <!-- manual: Copy the generated token — this is your password (API token) for authentication. -->
